questions.question: Select the most appropriate proverb that means the same as the given phrase.Two people can do a better job together than one person doing it alone.
options: Birds of the same feather flock together.
Two heads are better than one.
Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Two heads are better than one.) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Antarctica, the southernmost continent on Earth, is a land of extremes. With its icy landscapes, frigid temperatures, and harsh conditions, Antarctica presents a formidable environment for life. Let's embark on a journey to explore Antarctica's frozen frontier.One of the most striking features of Antarctica is its vast ice sheets, which cover more than 98% of the continent's surface. These ice sheets contain about 70% of the world's fresh water, making Antarctica the largest reservoir of freshwater on Earth. The continent's ice also plays a crucial role in regulating global climate patterns and sea levels, making it an essential area of study for scientists around the world.In addition to its ice, Antarctica is home to a surprising diversity of wildlife, from penguins and seals to whales and seabirds. These animals have adapted to life in one of the harshest environments on the planet, relying on each other and their surroundings for survival. Antarctica's marine ecosystems are particularly rich, with nutrient-rich waters supporting a complex food web that sustains a wide variety of species.Despite its remote location and harsh conditions, Antarctica has long captured the imagination of explorers and scientists alike.
